_comment: Discovery log entries. reward = credits granted once. unlock_text is shown in the discovery popup when the discovery unlocks something in the shop or elsewhere.

discoveries.name: Sleepy Scoopy
discoveries.desc: A little hover-bot, buried mid-nap for who knows how long. Its eye flickers when you brush off the dirt.
discoveries.unlock_text: Helper Bots are now available at the Outfitter.

discoveries.name: Somebody's Time Capsule
discoveries.desc: A tin full of bottle caps, a drawing of a rocket, and a note: 'Dig deeper. It's worth it.'

discoveries.name: Star Chart (Left Half)
discoveries.desc: Half of a glowing map. The torn edge points at a crystal-blue dot.
discoveries.unlock_text: Find the other half to chart a course to a new planet.

discoveries.name: Star Chart (Right Half)
discoveries.desc: The other half of the map, wedged between giant amethysts.
discoveries.unlock_text: Find the other half to chart a course to a new planet.

discoveries.name: Fossilised Drill Bit
discoveries.desc: An ancient spiral bit made of something harder than diamond. Somebody dug here before you.
discoveries.unlock_text: Fracture Bit attachment unlocked for drills!

discoveries.name: The Giant Seed
discoveries.desc: A fossil seed the size of a beach ball. Pipseed, it turns out, was planted.

discoveries.name: Dented Explorer Helmet
discoveries.desc: Scratched into the visor: 'The heart is real. I heard it.'

discoveries.name: Humming Idol
discoveries.desc: A small golden figure that vibrates in time with something far below.

discoveries.name: Survey Penetrator
discoveries.desc: A finned probe fired into the far side by an earlier expedition. Its sample core is still clipped on, labelled in a neat hand: 'Low Hollow - amethyst?'
discoveries.unlock_text: Survey data loaded: the map now shows what each region is rich in.

discoveries.name: The Crystal Grotto
discoveries.desc: A hidden geode cavern under the tallest hill, crowded with glowing amethyst spires.

discoveries.name: Mushroom Hollow
discoveries.desc: A cosy cave full of softly glowing mushrooms.

discoveries.name: The Deep Vault
discoveries.desc: A chamber far too round to be natural, sealed inside the granite.

discoveries.name: The Heart of Pipseed
discoveries.desc: At the very centre of the planet floats a warm, glowing seed. When you touch it, the whole world takes a breath.
discoveries.unlock_text: Pipseed's Blessing: +20% sell value forever. Planet Cracker and Mole Engine blueprints unlocked!

discoveries.name: The Old Workings
discoveries.desc: Timber sets, narrow rails and a tipped ore tub. Somebody dug here a long time ago and left in a hurry.

discoveries.name: The Low Geode
discoveries.desc: Under the far-side basin: a hollow lined wall to wall with amethyst.

discoveries.name: Glass Songbird
discoveries.desc: A tiny crystal bird. It chirps one perfect note when the light hits it.

discoveries.name: The Echo Bell
discoveries.desc: A bell grown, not made. Ring it and the whole moon answers.

discoveries.name: Prism Lens
discoveries.desc: A flawless lens that splits light into colours you don't have names for.

discoveries.name: The Grand Geode
discoveries.desc: A cathedral-sized crystal pocket inside the tallest spire.

discoveries.name: The Bell Chamber
discoveries.desc: Every footstep rings in here.

discoveries.name: The Heart of Glimmerock
discoveries.desc: A faceted heart of living crystal, turning slowly in the dark.
discoveries.unlock_text: Glimmer's Blessing: lucky gems are twice as likely.
